description: Impact of class balancing strategy on per-class precision and recall. All runs are YOLOv8s fine-tuned from COCO, same hyperparameters, same 4,820-image base dataset from the shipyard deployment, same epoch count (120). The only difference is the class-balancing strategy applied at training time.

base_dataset.notes: Heavily imbalanced: Crack and Overlap are rare; Porosity and Spatter are common. Rare classes are also the higher-severity classes.

strategies.name: no_rebalancing
strategies.description: Baseline: no sampler, no loss weighting, YOLO defaults.

strategies.name: class_aware_sampler
strategies.description: Class-aware sampler replacing default: images containing rare classes are sampled with probability inversely proportional to sqrt(class frequency).

strategies.name: class_aware_plus_loss_weighting
strategies.description: Class-aware sampler + cls_pw loss weighting inversely proportional to sqrt(class frequency).

strategies.name: class_aware_plus_loss_plus_extra_mosaic_rare
strategies.description: Adds an additional mosaic pass on rare-class images on top of YOLO's default mosaic=1.0.

strategies.name: synthetic_augmentation
strategies.description: Mixes synthetic rare-class images (generated via copy-paste from a small bank of crack/overlap crops) into the training set at 2:1 synthetic:real for rare classes.
strategies.notes: Copy-paste synthetic images closed the recall gap on Crack and Overlap but at the cost of precision; real labels remain the most reliable source.

takeaways: Class-aware sampler is the single most effective lever; ~+6 points aggregate mAP50 from the baseline.
Loss weighting stacks on top of the sampler but produces smaller marginal gains (+1 point aggregate).
The extra mosaic pass on rare-class images reliably raises Crack recall at negligible cost to majority-class metrics.
Synthetic augmentation is a viable last resort for cold-start deployments but real labels dominate once they exist.
Crack recall is the gating metric for the shipyard deployment; strategies without class-aware sampling do not hit the 0.80 threshold.
